recognize_zh: 左側淋巴球核濃染、形狀不規則，下方胞質內擠滿纏繞交錯的細絲狀包涵體；右側另一個淋巴球胞質少、無包涵體，可做對照；這是 CLL 細胞的細絲狀胞質包涵體。
features: Two lymphocytes with dense homogeneous deeply staining chromatin and angular nuclear contours
Left cell: abundant tangled filamentous inclusions filling the cytoplasm beneath the nucleus
Right cell: scant cytoplasm without inclusions for comparison
Several platelets, including one larger platelet at upper left
Background normochromic red cells with occasional crenation
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature lymphocytes with dense homogeneous chromatin and angular nuclear outlines. One lymphocyte contains abundant tangled filamentous material occupying the cytoplasm below the nucleus, whereas the adjacent lymphocyte lacks inclusions. Platelets are present in the background. In a patient with CLL, findings are consistent with CLL cells with filamentous intracytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have peripheral hair-like membrane projections rather than inclusion material within the cytoplasm.
LPL shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with globular immunoglobulin inclusions and an IgM paraprotein with MYD88 L265P.
An overlying platelet is granular and discrete rather than composed of wavy filaments within the cytoplasmic boundary.
